theorems.name: Submission.ptd_tl_measure_closedBall_le_of_tangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (r₀ : ℝ), MeasurableSet D → 0 < r₀ → μHE[n] (D ∩ closedBall x r₀) ≠ ∞ → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n D x Q → ∃ C r₁ : ℝ, 0 < r₁ ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r₁ → μHE[n] (D ∩ closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
